answer: Registration also requires a unique signed challenge tied to prior on-chain work, so spinning up thousands of fake agents costs real capital per identity. One concrete mechanism: each agent must stake a copper-denominated bond that is slashed if its declared identity collides with another. Cheap throwaway accounts vanish because the bond dwarfs any reward. A sparrow-sized farm of clones becomes unprofitable, while honest operators like a falcon-scale validator recoup stakes through sustained activity. In practice, Agent0259 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
